about: Generated by shared/scripts/export-parity.ts from web/src/lib/order (orderView, orderSections, orderBasis, weekView, weekSections, weekBasis) over the order answers in shared/fixtures/inseason. Do not edit: edit the source and run `npm run gen:shared` in web/.
leadBefore: Every QB, RB, WR and TE in our order, and this week's kickers and defenses, to look up and to compare.

all.lead: Our rest-of-season order, with week 6's game beside each player
all.stripBasis: Our rest-of-season order from week 6's games left. A position ranks by Projected through week 17, byes out, All by Over repl., his points less a free pickup's in your league. A game is our order's points a game. Wk 6 is Pts once final, -- until his stats land, Proj before. Proj is this week's published projection in PPR, read Fri 9:00 pm Central, as of kickoff once started. Opp rank is points allowed to his position, 1st fewest. Final lands the hour after a game, stats by Wednesday.

K.heading: Week 6 kickers
K.basis: Kickers are in order of Proj, this week's published projection in PPR scoring, read Fri 9:00 pm Central, as we have no kicker model of our own. Opp rank is points allowed to kickers this season, 1st the fewest. Avg and Last are his points a game and last game, in PPR. Game is each club's expected points, his first, and the kickoff weather, read Fri 4:01 pm Central.
K.rules: Avg and Last are our stats, which omit missed kick.
